name: Suprapatellar recess
location: Extension of knee joint capsule above patella; not a separate superficial bursa in usual adult anatomy
clinical_note: Shows fullness above patella as part of joint effusion; communicates with knee joint

name: Prepatellar
location: Superficial sliding plane between skin and patella
clinical_note: Focal swelling over patella from kneeling/trauma; 'housemaid's knee'

name: Superficial infrapatellar
clinical_note: Swelling below patella from upright kneeling; 'clergyman's knee'

name: Deep infrapatellar
location: Between distal patellar tendon and anterior tibia
clinical_note: Deep anterior pain; can mimic patellar tendinopathy

name: Semimembranosus-gastrocnemius
clinical_note: Can distend as Baker cyst; often with intra-articular pathology
